problem: Autonomous highway refueling stops fail to synchronize dynamically with computed route polygon boundaries, leading to out-of-bounds or missed fueling options during autonomous trip planning.
root_cause: The geospatial query handler lacks a real-time boundary polygon intersection check against the active route geometry when fetching candidate refueling stops from the Mapbox store locator / geospatial pipeline.
architecture: VoyPlan AI orchestrator daemon coordinates geospatial tools and map matching, leveraging spatial queries to filter points of interest along dynamic route corridors bounded by polygon geometries.
recommended_solution: Implement a dynamic polygon intersection filter within the orchestrator daemon's refueling candidate retrieval pipeline using Mapbox geospatial operations to ensure stops strictly fall inside or within tolerance of the active route polygon boundary.
risks: Increased computational overhead for frequent polygon intersection checks on long routes.
Potential empty result sets if route boundary tolerance is configured too restrictively.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate refueling stops returned by the AI planner strictly intersect or fall within the active route polygon boundary.
Dynamic updates to the route boundary automatically trigger a re-sync of refueling polygons.
Unit and integration tests validate spatial containment accuracy under various route geometries.

test_cases.name: test_refueling_polygon_sync_containment
test_cases.description: Verify that candidate stops outside the route polygon boundary are filtered out while those inside are retained.

test_cases.name: test_dynamic_route_boundary_update
test_cases.description: Simulate a dynamic route recalculation and ensure refueling stops re-sync correctly with the new boundary polygon.
